Norman opens the gateway despite Strange's warning, letting the alien through. Strange and Peter then destroy the gateway.
T:fox-pyro: John Allerdyce sets police cars ablaze, then leaves the X-Men to join Magneto at Alkali Lake.
C:fox-claws: In the smelting lab where his skeleton was made, Logan fights Stryker's adamantium-clawed Yuriko and kills her.
On Alcatraz, Logan's adamantium and healing let him walk through the Phoenix's fury, reach Jean and stab her.
C:fox-cerebro-stryker: Stryker builds a second Cerebro under Alkali Lake and forces a mind-controlled Xavier to aim it at every mutant.
Magneto turns it on humans instead. Storm's snowstorm frees Xavier before the bursting dam floods the base.
C:fox-x-jet: Fighter jets shoot it down, and Magneto catches it. At Alkali Lake, Jean lifts it clear of the flood.
The X-Jet flies the team to Alcatraz to fight Magneto's army.
When the Phoenix unleashes her power on Alcatraz, the X-Jet disintegrates along with much of the island.
The X-Jet carries the team to Liberty Island to stop Magneto's machine.
T:fox-anim-gyrich: After Master Mold turns on its makers, the X-Men capture Gyrich and force him to reveal where it is.
C:fox-anim-master-mold: Master Mold turns on its makers. Xavier flies the Blackbird into it, and only its head survives the blast.
An upgraded Master Mold leads the attack on Genosha, and Gambit dies destroying it.
C:fox-anim-blackbird: Xavier flies the Blackbird, packed with explosives and shielded by Magneto, into Master Mold.
C:star-lord-blasters: On Knowhere, Thanos turns Quill's shot at Gamora into bubbles. On Titan, Quill fights with his blasters, then turns to dust.
C:iron-spider: The suit flies to Peter on Maw's ship, and he fights Thanos in it on Titan. It turns to dust with him in the Snap.
The suit flies to Peter on Maw's ship, and he fights Thanos in it on Titan. It turns to dust with him in the Snap.
C:star-lord-mask: In a new mask, Peter fights Thanos on Titan, and the mask turns to dust with him in the Snap.
In space, he gives it to Gamora so she survives until the Ravagers pick them up. He wears it again over Xandar.
In a new mask, Peter fights Thanos on Titan, and the mask turns to dust with him in the Snap.
C:wasp-suit: Hope fights Kang's forces as the Wasp in the Quantum Realm.
C:cassie-suit: Cassie fights Kang's forces in a size-changing suit of her own.
T:bill-metzger: Metzger's Damage Control, which held telepath Sara Grey for the experiments that killed her, now holds Jean.
C:shocker-gauntlet: When the Hulk storms Damage Control, Peter wears the gauntlet against him, and the Hulk smashes it.
In Lagos, Brock Rumlow smashes through doors with the power gauntlets of his armored suit.
C:fox-mutant-cure: A cure dart meant for Magneto strips Mystique's powers. On Alcatraz, Hank injects Magneto with the cure.
C:iron-legion: Tony's Iron Legion drones help the Avengers raid Strucker's base in Sokovia.
C:chitauri-tech: In Sokovia, a HYDRA soldier fires a Chitauri gun at Iron Man before the Avengers take Strucker's base.
C:temporal-loom: Flooded by branching timelines, the TVA's Temporal Loom nears failure as Ouroboros races to fix it.
The Loom explodes. Reliving the moment, Loki destroys it himself and holds the branching timelines together.
C:throughput-multiplier: Ouroboros and Victor Timely build the Throughput Multiplier to save the overloaded Temporal Loom.
Timely is spaghettified before he can launch it, and even in Loki's later attempts the Loom fails.
T:pr-st-auran: Auran refuses Maximus's order to kill Medusa, then leaves him and joins the evacuation of Attilan to Earth.
C:pr-attilan-failsafe: Maximus reveals a failsafe that needs his fingerprints every hour to keep Attilan stable.
C:sv-itsv-collider: Kingpin builds a super collider to reach other universes, and its test pulls Spider-People into Miles's world.
Miles sends his friends home, then throws Kingpin into the kill switch, destroying the collider.
C:sv-itsv-override-key: Peter Parker, this world's Spider-Man, brings a flash drive built to shut down Kingpin's collider.
Miles plugs in the drive himself and sends the others home. The drive goes down with the collider.
C:sv-itsv-sp-dr: SP//dr is wrecked in the battle at the collider, and Peni goes home with only her spider.
C:statesman: Loki steals the Grandmaster's ship and flies it to Asgard to rescue its people.
C:spec-kronan: Korg, a gentle rock gladiator on Sakaar, leads the slaves' revolt and leaves with Thor's Asgardians.
C:sv-venom-life-foundation-rocket: Bonded to Riot, Carlton Drake readies a Life Foundation rocket to bring more symbiotes to Earth.
A:pr-sommerfield: Sommerfield builds the Daystar virus, but the vampires kill her when they raid the Nightstalkers.
C:pr-daystar: Blade stabs Drake with the Daystar arrow, and the finished virus spreads through the air, killing the vampires.
C:spec-frost-beast: A giant Frost Beast attacks Thor's party on Jotunheim, and Thor kills it by smashing right through it.
T:st-krista-dumont: Krista falls for her patient Billy and hides him from the law, until Madani throws her out a window. She survives the fall, badly hurt.
C:st-russo-mask: Billy's crew wears masks as he leads them on a spree of robbery and murder.
A:by-zombie-bruce-banner: He turns into the Hulk to hold off the zombie Wanda so his friends can escape.
C:fox-mutation-machine: Powered by Rogue atop the Statue of Liberty, it starts to work until Logan destroys it.
C:pr-fistigons: Chase fights Jonah with the Fistigons, then turns them on Morgan le Fay's sorcerers.
C:pr-corvus: WIZARD's free Corvus phones turn people violent, and Morgan plans to build an army with them.
Janet knocks out the Los Angeles phone service, and Tina banishes Morgan to the Dark Dimension.
C:spec-skrull: Dar-Benn tears the air from Tarnax IV, the Skrull world Carol helped found, and Valkyrie arrives to take its refugees in.
T:by-the-apex: Bruce Banner's attempt to purge the Hulk with gamma radiation creates the Apex, a kaiju that spawns gamma monsters.
C:by-mech-avengers-mechs: The Avengers build giant mechs to fight the Apex, but they are killed.
C:by-spec-gamma-monster: The Apex spawns gamma monsters that kill the Avengers. After Mega-Hulk kills the Apex, he leads the rest to his island.
C:gravimetric-spikes: Jane's group plants Selvig's gravimetric spikes in Greenwich and sends Malekith back to Svartalfheim.
C:cloak: The Cloak picks Strange in the New York Sanctum and helps him hold off Kaecilius.
It follows Strange aboard Ebony Maw's ship and helps Tony and Peter rescue him, and later turns to dust with him in the Snap.
A:by-the-watcher: Glimpsed only as a face in shattered glass, the Watcher looks on as Bullseye and Daredevil crash out of Fogwell's Gym.
In 1896, the Watcher looks on as Prince Tafari and Kuda try to leave Adwa with a vibranium ax.
C:spec-watcher: Glimpsed only as a face in shattered glass, a Watcher looks on as Bullseye and Daredevil crash out of Fogwell's Gym.
In 1896, a Watcher looks on as Prince Tafari and Kuda try to flee Adwa with a vibranium axe.
C:sv-1994-doomsday-device: The Red Skull's Doomsday Device charges his son Kragov with electricity, turning him into Electro.
A:fox-x-men: In 2023, the last X-Men hide from the Sentinels in a Chinese temple and send Logan's mind back to 1973.
C:ammit-ushabti: At the pyramids, Harrow smashes it to free Ammit.
C:sv-spec-gorth: Infinata destroys Gorth, and its last scientist dies on Earth after giving Spider-Man the planet's knowledge.
C:fox-anim-magneto-helmet: Apocalypse vaporizes Magneto in ancient Egypt, and only his helmet is left for Xavier to hold.
C:fox-anim-ship: In 3000 B.C., the X-Men find the Ship, and through it En Sabah Nur becomes Apocalypse.
A:fox-anim-magneto: Presumed dead at Genosha, Magneto is really Bastion's prisoner until Valerie Cooper sets him free.
C:fox-anim-sentinels: Sentinels massacre Genosha, and Bastion turns humans into Prime Sentinels to attack mutants worldwide.
C:fox-anim-gambit-cards: Gambit dies destroying Master Mold. Apocalypse later finds one of his cards in Genosha.
C:helicarrier: Fury flies the old Helicarrier to Sokovia, and its lifeboats carry the people to safety.
Loki's agents attack the Helicarrier, S.H.I.E.L.D.'s flying base. Tony and Steve restart a damaged engine.
C:hadron-enforcer: Rocket's big gun helps shatter Ronan's warhammer on Xandar.
C:dark-aster: Ronan rules from his flagship and flies it to Xandar to destroy the planet.
Rocket crashes a ship through it, and the Dark Aster crash-lands on Xandar.
C:spec-kree: The Kree sign a peace treaty with Xandar, but the fanatic Ronan rejects it and tries to destroy the planet.
C:spec-xandarian: Ronan tries to wipe out Xandar, but the Nova Corps and the Guardians save the planet.
C:spec-sakaaran: Sakaaran soldiers fight for Ronan and fall by the hundreds in his attack on Xandar.
C:kimoyo-beads: Shuri scans Vision with her beads, and T'Challa calls her through his as Thanos's army attacks Wakanda.
C:redwing: In Wakanda, Sam sends Redwing slicing through Thanos's army, and it is left behind when Sam turns to dust.
A:reed-richards: Reed takes the team into space to face Galactus, who demands his unborn son.
A:sue-storm: Sue, pregnant with Franklin, gives birth during the team's escape from Galactus.
T:galactus: Galactus comes to devour Earth and demands Sue's unborn son Franklin in exchange.
T:mole-man: At peace with the surface thanks to Sue, Mole Man shelters New York's evacuated people in Subterranea when Galactus comes.
C:excelsior: The Fantastic Four fly the Excelsior out to face Galactus and wreck its FTL drive at a neutron star to escape. Franklin is born aboard.
C:surfer-board: The Silver Surfer rides her board through space for Galactus and brings it to Earth to warn of his coming.
Shalla-Bal drives Galactus through the portal herself and vanishes with him.
C:teleport-bridges: Reed's teleportation bridges are built worldwide. The Surfer wrecks most of them, and the last one sends Galactus away.
C:spec-moloid: Mole Man's people of Subterranea shelter New York's evacuees underground when Galactus comes.
T:st-alexandra: Alexandra raises Elektra as the Black Sky to reach the treasure under Midland Circle.
T:st-murakami: Murakami fights the Defenders as the Hand digs under Midland Circle.
C:st-dd-suit: Matt puts the suit back on to fight the Hand, and is buried in it as Midland Circle collapses.
C:st-elektra-sai: Revived as the Black Sky, Elektra takes her old sai from a Hand display and kills Alexandra. She is caught inside as Midland Circle falls.
C:st-hand-substance: Midland Circle implodes on the cavern as the Hand harvests the dragon's skeleton.
C:st-colleen-katana: Colleen beheads Bakuto beneath Midland Circle.
C:bucky-arm: Wakanda gives Bucky a new vibranium arm before Thanos's army attacks. It turns to dust with him in the Snap.
C:black-panther-suit: T'Challa leads Wakanda's army against Thanos's forces, and the suit turns to dust with him in the Snap.
C:sv-raimi-octavius-arms: Peter talks Otto back to himself, and Otto drowns his reactor in the river, sinking with the arms.
Otto Octavius runs his fusion demo with four AI-driven arms, kept in check by an inhibitor chip.
The failed demo fuses the arms to his spine and destroys the chip, and the arms take control of Otto.
C:sv-raimi-fusion-reactor: Otto rebuilds it in a harbor warehouse and trades Spider-Man to Harry for the tritium to fuel it.
As the new reactor runs wild, Otto drowns it in the river to save the city.
Otto Octavius shows off his Oscorp-funded fusion reactor in a public demo.
A:by-tony-killmonger: Tony confronts Killmonger, who kills him and makes it look like a Wakandan attack.
C:by-killmonger-drones: After Tony's death, Ross sends the drone army against Wakanda, where it is defeated.
C:sv-morbius-bat-serum: Michael splices vampire bat genes into himself aboard a ship at sea, and the cure turns him into a vampire.
A:fox-deadpool: Back home, Wade and a Logan variant destroy the Time Ripper together and save their universe.
C:time-ripper: Mr. Paradox readies a Time Ripper to speed up the death of Deadpool's universe.
Cassandra Nova follows Wade and Logan to Earth-10005 and takes over the Time Ripper to destroy every timeline.
C:fox-spec-anim-dbari: Dark Phoenix consumes a star, and the Shi'ar declare she destroyed the D'Bari solar system.
C:fox-hanks-jet: Hank pilots his jet, carrying the team and Moira to the Cuban blockade.
Riptide's whirlwind brings the jet down on the beach.
C:fox-shaw-submarine: Shaw shadows the Soviet fleet in his submarine to make sure the missiles reach Cuba.
Erik lifts the submarine out of the sea and drops it on the Cuban beach.
A:pr-frankie-raye: Captain Raye works with the military to catch the Silver Surfer and reconnects with Johnny.
C:st-chula-garment: Maya finds it finished at Chula's home and wears it to face Fisk at the powwow.
C:st-monster-truck: Biscuits drives a monster truck through Fisk's men at the powwow.
C:by-dark-aster-nova: Ronan's ship, the Dark Aster, comes for Xandar after his coup against Thanos.
C:by-spec-xandarian-nova: Xandar seals itself behind a planetary shield against Ronan, and Nebula stops Nova Prime from surrendering it.
C:by-spec-kree-nova: Ronan overthrows Thanos and besieges Xandar, until the planet's shield crushes the Dark Aster and kills him.
C:fox-dopinder-taxi: Dopinder runs over the orphanage headmaster with his taxi.
C:wakandan-axe: In 1896, Prince Tafari takes the vibranium axe from the battlefield at Adwa to bring it home.
C:st-fake-dd-suit: Wearing it, Dex kills Jasper Evans at the Bulletin and Father Lantom at Clinton Church.
C:st-karen-380: Karen aims her .380 at Dex at the Bulletin, but he takes it, kills Jasper Evans with it and pulls it apart.
A:jack-duquesne: Fisk blackmails Jack, who is secretly the vigilante Swordsman. When Fisk outlaws vigilantes, he locks Jack up at Red Hook.
A:st-frank-castle: Frank fights beside Matt, then is captured by Fisk's Task Force and held at Red Hook. He tricks a guard to escape.
C:sv-ssm-rhino-suit: The Rhino destroys the specs that could be used to copy his suit. After a breakout from the Vault, he is gassed and locked up again.
C:sv-ssm-web-shooters: Locked in the Vault as a test, Peter webs over his whole cell and smokes out the guards with a web cartridge.
C:fox-sentinels: In 1973, Magneto laces Trask's prototypes with steel and turns them on the White House.
C:commodore: The wrecked ship drifts beside the Statesman as Thanos attacks, and it is destroyed when the Statesman explodes.
C:sv-raimi-goblin-glider: As the Green Goblin, Norman flies Oscorp's military glider into the Unity Day festival and attacks.
C:sv-raimi-pumpkin-bombs: The Green Goblin kills Oscorp's board with a pumpkin bomb at the Unity Day festival.
C:fox-spec-phalanx: The Phalanx try to assimilate all life on Earth, until Warlock spreads Beast's virus and destroys them.
C:pr-dd-baton: Bullseye steals the baton and impales Nikolas Natchios with it, leaving it behind to frame Daredevil.
